annotations.title: Approve or hold a scheduled post

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] decision "approve" sends a held post to the platform for its slot (GOES LIVE) — needs the explicit `review` scope (admin does not include it) and never works on a post the same connection created. decision "hold" takes a scheduled post off the platform schedule — needs `review` or `publish`. Agency plan. `id` is a reviewId or a convexPostId.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/reviews/{id}.)

collabSide.description: FFE-501 collab posts only: which brand this decision is for ("owner" = the shared character's brand, "grantee" = the brand that made the post). Needed only when the key's owner approves for both brands; a brand-bound key always decides for its own brand. A collab post publishes only after BOTH sides approved; "hold" rejects it for good.

id.description: A convexPostId or a review id.

pastSlot.description: Only for a held post whose slot passed: "now", or { at: ISO-8601 future time }.
